systems.system: Ogun State Digital Economy Infrastructure Project fibre network
systems.country_label: Ogun State Digital Economic Empowerment Project (OGDEIP)
systems.platform: fibre-optic network; first phase a ring around the state
systems.owner: Ogun State Government jointly with 21st Century Technologies Limited, which put in close to US$75 million
systems.tiers: planned across all 20 local government areas of Ogun State within two years of the April 2021 flag-off; the first phase is to connect key educational institutions, government agencies and residents; no local government office named

note: A state fibre project flagged off in April 2021: it is to reach all 20 local government areas of Ogun State, but no local government office is said to be connected.
